SELECT ASSIGNEE_ as assignee,count(*) as total from act_hi_taskinst RES INNER JOIN ACT_HI_PROCINST P ON RES.PROC_INST_ID_ = P.PROC_INST_ID_
INNER JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT htk.PROC_INST_ID_,
htk.TASK_DEF_KEY_,
MAX( htk.END_TIME_ ) AS END_TIME_ FROM act_hi_taskinst htk
htk.DELETE_REASON_ != 'delete' AND htk.DELETE_REASON_ != 'reback' AND htk.DELETE_REASON_ != 'TansunBackDelete'
AND htk.ASSIGNEE_ in
#{assignee}
GROUP BY
htk.TASK_DEF_KEY_,
htk.PROC_INST_ID_ ORDER BY htk.PROC_INST_ID_) singleHi ON RES.PROC_INST_ID_ = singleHi.PROC_INST_ID_ AND RES.END_TIME_ = singleHi.END_TIME_
RES.DELETE_REASON_ !='delete' AND RES.DELETE_REASON_ !='reback' AND RES.DELETE_REASON_ !='TansunBackDelete' AND RES.END_TIME_ is not null AND ASSIGNEE_ in
#{assignee}
AND RES.TENANT_ID_ = #{tenantId}
AND p.END_TIME_ is not null
AND p.END_TIME_ is null
GROUP BY ASSIGNEE_
